title: AS2 array and string built-in method compilation
description: Flash 8 AS2 code commonly uses Array and String methods. Add compiler built-in support so these compile to efficient AVM1 bytecode: (1) Array methods: push(v) → ActionPush 'push', ActionCallMethod; pop() → 'pop'; shift()/unshift(v); splice(i,n,...); join(sep); reverse(); sort(); slice(i,j); concat(...); Array.from is not needed; (2) String methods: split(sep) → 'split' CallMethod; indexOf(str,from); lastIndexOf; charAt(i); charCodeAt(i); substring(i,j); toUpperCase/toLowerCase(); trim is not in Flash 8; String.fromCharCode(n) → ActionMbStringExtract or ActionStringExtract; (3) Math object: Math.floor/ceil/round/abs/min/max/sqrt/pow/random → ActionCallFunction or ActionGetVariable 'Math' + CallMethod; (4) These do NOT require new opcodes — they're all compiled as regular method calls (ActionGetVariable + ActionGetMember + ActionCall). The point is to verify the compiler handles chained method calls like arr.push(1) correctly. Write tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/builtins.test.ts verifying these compile to valid bytecode. Only touches packages/core/src/as2/.
